ruleDefinitions.name: RDP over Reverse SSH Tunnel WFP
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects svchost hosting RDP termsvcs communicating with the loopback address Note: Unmapped fields: DestAddress, DestPort, FilterOrigin, Application

sequences.query: event_id = 5156 AND ((src_port = 3389 AND (DestAddress = "127\.*" OR DestAddress = "\:\:1")) OR (DestPort = 3389 AND (src_ip = "127\.*" OR src_ip = "\:\:1"))) AND  NOT (FilterOrigin = "AppContainer\ Loopback" OR (Application = RGX("\\\\thor\\\.exe$") OR Application = RGX("\\\\thor64\\\.exe$")))
